name: Reference week
description: Friday has a live quote and confirmed capacity for the Friday slot. Nothing binding is on file for Monday at Friday's decision.

name: Pre-agreed Monday terms
description: Before Friday's cutoff the provider has agreed Monday forward terms and reserved Monday capacity for a SGD 25.00 fee, and a fallback route is documented.

name: Forecast customer receipt
description: Settled cash is SGD 180,000. A SGD 25,000 customer receipt is forecast for Monday but has not settled.

name: Concurrent payout
description: A second supplier payout of SGD 30,000 draws on the same balance before the deadline.

name: Short-lived Monday quote
description: The only Monday quote on file on Friday is valid until Friday 18:00 SGT.

name: Monday closed
description: On Friday morning the provider confirms Monday 16 Nov is not a business day.

name: Monday capacity check
description: Same Friday evidence as the reference week. Monday's payout capacity is only checked at the Monday checkpoint.

name: Slow last mile
description: The simulated last-mile bound is 9 hours, so a 15:00 SGT release lands after the 23:00 SGT deadline.
